scenes.say: Imagine paying thirty point five cents a kilowatt-hour for electricity. That's Massachusetts.
That's bad for your bills. But great for solar.
Eversource, National Grid, and Unitil credit exports at the full retail rate.
The SMART three program pays three cents for every kilowatt-hour you produce, locked for twenty years.
Plus a fifteen percent state tax credit and tax exemptions.
Put together, a typical system pays back in about six to seven years.
Going solar in Massachusetts? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
